replies.author: Fouled
replies.body:
The wool rooms are too close to spawn and the pathway isn't big enough to build a good defense.
It seems like the map is too "random". There's not really a block pattern, but just a mixture of blocks using world edit.
Other then that, there's not really much else to say with the amount of screenshots provided.
